purpose: The two rebrand directions Oskar picked, expanded from his references. The other seven are in ../archive/vibes/.

arena.status: Private; unavailable to browse. No images attributed to the board.

oskar.role: Original direction board: left Sun Spell, centre Neon Dream, right Cosmic Scribble. Corresponding panel informs all four images in each set.
Soft-lit 3D massing, tall grassy pillars, pink clouds and top-down readability inform Sun Spell’s title, match and lobby.

directions.name: Sun Spell
directions.creator: Oskar
pitch: A caped star, a cloud and a leaf sprite scrap on grassy stone islands above warm pink clouds.
directions.build: Extruded star, puff spheres and leaf planes; tall rock prisms with grassy tile caps. Warm baked light, a quiet pencil-grain tile and simple waterfall ribbons.

images.label: Key art / title screen
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver ONE LANDSCAPE 16:9 image for a fast, snappy 3v3 hero brawler. Faithfully translate Oskar's attached concept into a BUILDABLE Three.js sketch look: chunky cheap low-poly rock prisms, flat extruded silhouettes, clustered spheres, leaf planes; mostly flat colour with at most two-tone soft baked lighting; crisp thick charcoal outlines on creatures and UI, sparse coloured-pencil/crayon grain from one quiet scenery texture. Soft printed ellipse shadows, simple billboard glow rings, dashed projectile arc. Joyful small creature heroes, NO humanoid warriors, no medieval fantasy, no cyberpunk technology even where the name says Neon. Keep silhouettes tiny-camera readable, scenery detail at perimeter, uninterrupted playable floor and clear lanes. NO complicated sculpting, no photoreal surfaces, no dense painted microdetail, no ornate architecture, no big cinematic VFX, no unrequested text. Only render the requested asset, never a collage or extra panel.
Input images: REFERENCE IMAGES ONLY, not edit targets. LEFT PANEL ONLY of reference image 1. Keep the friendly giant smiling golden crescent moon, mint grassy caps over lavender rock, warm peach sky and pink clouds, orange trumpet flowers, pale butter-green arena, blue-white waterfalls and simple lavender stone arches. The reference image 2 supplies tall stone pillars with grassy tiled caps, warm pink cloud depth, overhead readable props and soft-lit chunky 3D massing. Borrow that construction and light, not its human hero or medieval buildings. Preserve the playful drawn world of image 1.
Creature designs: Exactly three creature identities: (1) a chunky yellow five-point STAR whose whole body is the star, black dot eyes, tiny plum feet and little indigo cape, no human body; (2) a squat lilac CLOUD made of 5 round puff spheres, dot eyes, tiny hands and stubby feet; (3) a small mint LEAF SPRITE with round cream face, green pear-shaped body, two large leaf ears above its head and tiny feet. Charming expressive faces, friendly mischief, inexpensive geometry. Keep these same identities across all four views.
Asset: Create the KEY ART / TITLE SCREEN. One wide, three-quarter, bold cheerful image. Three described heroes in a small lively scuffle on their island, one glowing ball and a dashed throw arc. Clear negative space upper left for exact game title 'Sun Spell', hand-lettered with chunky ink edges. Beneath title, exact small tagline 'Bright spaces, brighter mischief', and a cream thick-ink 'PLAY' button. Let the surround establish the world. The heroes are the same cheap primitives the gameplay could use. No other text. No separate panels.
Environment: One connected broad pale butter-green grassy arena cap on a tall lavender faceted rock pillar, with two generous traversable lanes around two or four low stone-block covers, short chunky objective posts at team ends, little grass clumps and orange flowers only at rim. Waterfall ribbons fall from outside edges into pink clouds. Detached scenic pillars distant, smiling moon overhead. A warm orange-gold glowing ball with a thin dashed orange arc is contested.

directions.name: Neon Dream
directions.creator: Oskar
pitch: Little luminous creatures settle quick fights on violet islands inside a sleeping flower jungle.
directions.build: Violet rock prisms, flat leaf fans and bell flowers; luminous dots and halo billboards at the perimeter. Inked pale creatures stay clear against a quiet violet floor.
